_doc: Caption presets rendered as ASS subtitles by app/pipeline/captions.py. Colors are #RRGGBB. 'mode': word (one word at a time), chunk (a short phrase with the active word highlighted), stack (small lead-in line + big keyword), boxed (bold pill backdrop). Fonts live in backend/fonts.

hormozi.name: Hormozi Bold Yellow/White
hormozi.description: Heavy uppercase, crisp stroke + depth shadow, active word in cyber gold, mint keyword pop.

viral_amber.name: Gold Rush Podcast
viral_amber.description: Italic heavy Montserrat in bright white with molten gold active word and coral highlights.

capcut_highlight.name: Creator Violet Pop
capcut_highlight.description: Punchy Reels look: snow-white words with electric magenta active word and mint keyword pops.

single_word_pop.name: Single Word Pop
single_word_pop.description: One condensed word at a time, center screen, vivid multi-color pops on numbers and keywords.

netflix_kinetic.name: Netflix Kinetic
netflix_kinetic.description: Tall cinematic caps, scarlet red punch, active word slams in with scale + depth shadow.

neon_glow.name: Neon Glow
neon_glow.description: Refined serif words with an electric multi-color neon halo that shifts per keyword.

cyber_electric.name: Cyber Neon Duo
cyber_electric.description: Uppercase Montserrat encased in a glowing cyan-magenta-volt aura for gaming and tech.

gaming_stack.name: Gaming Stack
gaming_stack.description: Crisp lead-in line with a giant italic electric keyword stacked right beneath.

luxury_serif.name: Editorial Gold
luxury_serif.description: Warm champagne serif italic with luxury amber highlights and soft cinema shadow.

minimal_clean.name: Minimalist Clean

cinematic_cyan.name: Cinematic Single Word
cinematic_cyan.description: Wide-tracked uppercase ice cyan words with gold keyword sparks. Luxury storytelling vibe.

bold_boxed.name: Boxed High-Contrast
bold_boxed.description: Crisp white phrase over a dark backdrop pill with electric gold + cyan word pops.
